title: Corroboration record
description: How many INDEPENDENT sources agree on each group of fields, what they disagree about, and what is still unresolved. This exists because the claim 'confirmed by at least three of: datasheet, schematic, variant header, community firmware' was previously a prose note that nothing could check - which is the same 'correct and unenforceable' failure the paired electronics-design skill was built to prevent.

id.description: Short stable handle, used to detect the same source cited twice.

kind.description: What sort of source this is. Only independent kinds count toward a corroboration threshold: listing, product_page, faq and pinout_image never do.

ref.description: Enough to find it again: a document section, a file path in a named repository, a schematic revision, or the instrument and date for a measurement. A citation you cannot re-check is not a citation.

derives_from.description: The id of the source this one copies. Two documents that share an upstream are ONE source however many times they are cited - a vendor FAQ restating a datasheet corroborates nothing.

sources.description: Source ids from the top-level sources list that were actually consulted FOR THIS GROUP. Citing a datasheet for the pin map does not corroborate the power section.

agreement.description: full = every consulted source says the same thing. partial = they agree on most of it and the exceptions are listed in contradictions. conflicting = they do not agree and the profile records both readings.

sources.description: Every source consulted for this profile, once each. May legitimately be empty on a fresh scaffold - the linter, not the schema, enforces how many are needed before a profile may leave draft.

groups.description: Per field-group corroboration. Board groups: gpio_map, strapping, adc, rtc_wake, power, mechanical, radio. Part groups: footprint, electrical, addressing.

conservative.description: This profile deliberately OVER-reserves: when unsure whether a pin is free it marks it consumed. That failure mode is safe - it refuses a pin that would have worked - so a conservative profile may go active on weaker corroboration. The reverse is never allowed: a profile may not bless pins as free on weak evidence.

conservative_rationale.description: Required when conservative is true. Say what the profile over-reserves and why that is the safe direction here.

contradictions.description: Sources that disagree. Record BOTH readings. Never average them, never pick one silently, and never smooth a disagreement into a single confident number.

resolution.description: unresolved = nobody has settled it, and the profile must not present either reading as fact. measured = an instrument settled it. chosen = one reading was adopted for a stated reason, which is weaker than measured and must say so.

impact.description: What depends on this number. A contradiction with no impact is trivia; one that drives a battery decision is not.

open_questions.description: Things nobody has looked up yet, as opposed to things sources disagree about.

blocks_active.description: True when this question must be answered before the profile may leave draft.
